notes: Direct HTTP fetch of www.seletti.it (Shopify, no blocking). Main nav / meganav exposes a single flat top-level link labeled 'Sales' -> /collections/last-chance (URL handle is 'last-chance', a clearance/last-chance target term, but the on-page H1 and nav label both display the generic word 'Sales'). Confirmed it is a genuine PLP: filterable/sortable product grid, on-page rendered text '134 products'. qty verified two ways: (1) exhaustion-paging /collections/last-chance/products.json?limit=250 -> single page of 134 unique product ids, (2) on-page displayed count '134 products' -- both agree, overriding collections.json metadata (136, inflated by 2). SALE VS CLEARANCE JUDGMENT: checked the rendered page for permanence language (outlet, ultimi pezzi, ultima chance, liquidazione, sconto permanente, final sale, end of line, discontinued) -- none present; the page is undecorated beyond a generic 'Sales' collection grid with a promotional countdown-timer widget. However it is NOT one of the site's clearly time-boxed seasonal campaigns (those exist separately and are excluded: black-friday/black-friday-24/black-friday-25, winter-sale-2025, summer-sales-2026) -- 'Sales' (handle last-chance) is instead a standing, always-present main-nav item alongside Best Seller and New Arrival, and its URL slug itself is one of the brief's listed clearance target terms ('Last Chance'). Could not confirm on-page whether stock here is permanently discontinued/outlet vs a rolling markdown promotion, so recording per brief instruction with a manual-review flag rather than guessing either way. Checked for a distinct 'Outlet' PLP separately: the only 'outlet' hit on the whole site is a blog post about a physical pop-up outlet event (/blogs/notizie/seletti-outlet-2026-4-20-giugno), not an online product listing -- not included as it has no product grid. No Italian-language clearance term (Liquidazione, Ultimi Pezzi) found as a separate collection; site UI is English throughout.

Could not confirm permanence of markdown vs rolling promotion.
